    • compareAndSet

      public CasResult compareAndSet(String key, String expectedToken, byte[] value, String newToken, Duration ttl)
      Writes a new value and token only if the atom's current token equals expectedToken, resetting its TTL on success. Implementations must perform the comparison and the write as one atomic operation — no lost update may be possible under concurrent writers.

      NATS KV offers no transaction, so the outcome is determined in two parts. The write itself is exact: update with the revision observed by the preceding read is an atomic compare-and-swap, so no lost update is possible. Classifying a failed write requires a follow-up read, and if the atom is deleted between the failed update and that read, the failure is reported as CasResult.ABSENT rather than CasResult.TOKEN_MISMATCH. Both outcomes mean the caller lost the race, and ABSENT is a true statement about the atom at the moment it was read.

      Parameters:
      key - the backend storage key
      expectedToken - the token the caller last observed
      value - the new serialized payload
      newToken - the new opaque staleness marker
      ttl - the new time-to-live
      Returns:
      CasResult.COMMITTED if written, CasResult.TOKEN_MISMATCH if a live atom exists with a different token, CasResult.ABSENT if no live atom exists
